subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw approve advancing the per-agent SQLite schema from version 10 to 11 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics in this PR?
rationale: Repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version advancement for explicit human acceptance, and the decision affects upgrades, retained diagnostics, and the public replacement for streamLogPath.

options.title: Approve after compatibility proof
options.body: Approve schema version 11 only after the public diagnostic contracts are preserved or replaced and a redacted real fresh-install and upgrade transcript verifies migration and cleanup behavior.

options.title: Split the schema change
options.body: Land the shared audit and memory migrations separately while moving the ACP table and schema-version decision into a narrower reviewed PR.

options.title: Retain the named artifact
options.body: Keep ACP relay history as a bounded named diagnostic artifact until maintainers approve a query or export surface for SQLite-backed history.

recommendation.title: Approve after compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Approve schema version 11 only after the public diagnostic contracts are preserved or replaced and a redacted real fresh-install and upgrade transcript verifies migration and cleanup behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the adjacent per-agent SQLite schema and migration architecture now being extended.
